dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: ...Already this late, huh. Morning prayers must've begun already. Forget it, I'll skip 'em.

choices.text: Did you stay up drinking all night?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: I'm working right now, y'know.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: See that fresh face? He came into the tavern just when it was getting dark. Got straight to drinking and bragging with the adventurers.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Anything suspicious about him?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: He claims to be an experienced merchant from Liyue. The tavern's warm, but he's very uncomfortable, doing all he can to cover the marks on his skin with his clothes.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: And he's got freshly frostbitten fingers. You see them when he takes his gloves off to shake hands.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, he's been someplace cold, huh?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Yes. Such as Dragonspine's foothills, before coming here for his own reasons.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: And as for the lie...

response.speaker: Stanley
response.text: ...Want me as your guard, huh? Well, you've come to the right guy!

response.speaker: Lambda
response.text: ...I've heard much about your deeds, Mr. Stanley, but I'm afraid... Yes, we still don't have quite enough people.

response.speaker: Lambda
response.text: See, a little bird told me that the legendary Treasure Hoarder, "Big Sis of the South," has the batch of goods I'm moving to Liyue in her sights.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Stanley, want me to talk to Katheryne about this and help this good gentleman out a bit? I wasn't planning on running any errands in Dornman Port anyway.

response.speaker: Lambda
response.text: Ah, that would be wonderful. I can't thank you enough. Dornman Port, you say... Isn't that quite close to Mondstadt? That should make our route very safe indeed.

response.speaker: Lambda
response.text: Of course, I'll still need the bulk of the manpower on my end instead. Money's no object, so just gather as many of your comrades as you can.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Thus giving you a chance to waylay the goods at Dornman Port, I presume?

response.speaker: Lambda
response.text: What... What are you talking about!?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Come with me, my "good gentleman." A warm tavern isn't the right place for what I want to talk to you about next.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Wait, Sister... Is something the matter with him?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Since when does "Big Sis of the South" ever tip her hand before she makes her move?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Luring troublesome opponents away from their posts... You Treasure Hoarders haven't learned any new tricks even after all this time.

response.speaker: Lambda
response.text: I... I don't know any Treasure Hoarders. I'm innocent, you hear!?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: What I hear is that, as it just so happens, the Knights of Favonius caught some Treasure Hoarders making camp in the Dragonspine foothills.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Since you're innocent, I'm sure you wouldn't mind coming with me to see them. They won't recognize you, will they?

response.speaker: Lambda
response.text: Ugh...! You...!

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Don't even think about running.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Exposing your back to me was a bad move.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Come on, then. I'll give you a choice — you can talk to the Knights, or you can talk to me.

choices.text: Would cross Dragonspine to get from Liyue to Mondstadt?
